name: SPN AI job scanner
operator: Student Property Network (the vendor, which runs the scanner for its own app)
basis: Student Property Network's own public pages (product, documentation, blog, customer stories, legal and security pages)
what: Python scrapers collect roles from UK real estate firms' careers pages into a database; a large language model decides whether each role is accepted onto the list, and accepted roles appear in the app and site.
note: A scan of a product as its vendor documents it, not of any one deployment. Made by the report studio: a researcher-assessor, a challenger, then the scorer. The company was interviewed on the record by PrompTugal.news; where an answer rests on the interview page, its note says so.
grant_note: Not measured. No deployment shape for this product is published in the capability grammar.
